name: Extra Block Types (EBT): Block
description: Config-only EBT block type that embeds any Drupal block (Views, content block, programmatic) via Block Field, wrapped with the shared EBT design settings.
project_description: EBT Block ships a single config-only block_content type (ebt_block) that embeds any Drupal block — a View, a custom content block, or a programmatically defined block — through the Block Field module, and wraps it in the Extra Block Types (EBT) design layer. It provides no PHP of its own: it installs a block type with a Body field, a field_ebt_block_block (block_field) field for selecting the embedded block, and a field_ebt_settings (ebt_settings) field contributed by the base ebt_core module for margin/padding/border/background/container design options, plus form and view displays and two Twig block templates. It is one member of the larger EBT family of standalone styled block types and is intended to be placed with Layout Builder.
